scope: Deterministic targeted controlled operator-index search from the unmodified simple founder. Each witness replays the actual mutatePlan authority, including current draft viability and /2 optional loss. Search goals guide this diagnostic only; ordinary mutations are unchanged. Not sampled births, inheritance frequencies, recombination proof, funded development, survival, reproduction or functional-physics acceptance.
search: Best-first prerequisite-distance heuristic; full serialized-body deduplication; both mutation symmetry branches enumerated at every expanded state. Depth, expansion and frontier bounds are explicit. Failure to find a witness never establishes impossibility. Witnesses are not certified shortest paths.
